description: Defines the BuzzPostDecorator class which decorates a BuzzPost entity with additional behaviors, including setting its associated Employee by employee number. The class uses traits for ORM helpers and manages a BuzzPost object, providing methods to interact with and modify it.

classes.name: BuzzPostDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for BuzzPost entity, providing methods to set associated Employee and manage the BuzzPost object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a BuzzPost instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with the BuzzPost using the employee's number.
